verseText: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
intro: September is here! Celebrate fall, praise God, open your Bible, get moving, and enjoy this month's brand-new coloring page and activity sheet.

read.title: Open Your Bible
read.text: Find Psalm 100:4-5. Read it out loud with somebody in your family. What does the Bible tell us to enter His gates with?

move.title: Fall Praise Moves
move.text: Do 3 praise jumps, 3 big claps, and 3 reaches toward the sky. Then say: Praise God!

learn.title: Bible Challenge
learn.question: According to Psalm 100:4, how should we enter His gates and His courts?

artistWallMessage: September's fall coloring page and Bible activity are here!
completionMessage: 🏆 September Bible Adventure Complete! Great job!
